# WinFulltime

> Data-driven football predictions, in-play alerts and expert analysis for smart bettors. Free daily picks across 1X2, Over/Under, BTTS, Corners, Cards, and streak markets, built from statistical models and head-to-head analysis.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://winfulltime.com/): Today's free football predictions across all markets.
- [Best Picks](https://winfulltime.com/best-picks.html): The single highest-confidence pick per category for today.
- [Author Picks](https://winfulltime.com/author-picks.html): Curated daily picks, one best market per fixture based on head-to-head analysis.
- [2 Odds of the Day](https://winfulltime.com/2-odds-of-the-day.html): Two low-odds selections for today, chosen for safety.
- [In-Play Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/in-play): Live in-play predictions and alerts.
- [Match Analysis](https://winfulltime.com/analysis.html): Full statistical analysis for today's matches.
- [Ticket Builder](https://winfulltime.com/ticket-builder.html): Build and optimize accumulator tickets from today's picks.
- [Booking Code Converter](https://winfulltime.com/converter.html): Decode and convert booking codes between SportyBet, MSport, Bet9ja, and Betway.
- [Blog](https://winfulltime.com/blog/): Betting guides, strategies, and bookmaker reviews.
- [About](https://winfulltime.com/about.html): Who we are and how WinFulltime predictions work.
- [Contact](https://winfulltime.com/contact.html): Contact the WinFulltime team.

## Predictions

- [1X2 Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/1x2): Home, draw, and away win predictions.
- [Over 1.5 Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/over-1-5): Matches tipped for more than 1.5 total goals.
- [Over 2.5 Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/over-2-5): Matches tipped for more than 2.5 total goals.
- [BTTS Yes Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/btts): Both teams to score predictions.
- [BTTS No Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/btts-no): Both teams to score NO predictions.
- [Unbeaten Teams](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/unbeaten): Teams currently unbeaten and their next fixtures.
- [Corners Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/corners): Corner count predictions.
- [Cards Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/cards): Cards market predictions.
- [Winning Streak](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/winning-streak): Teams on winning runs and their next fixtures.
- [Losing Streak](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/losing-streak): Teams on losing runs and their next fixtures.
- [Draw Streak](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/draws-streak): Teams stuck in draw runs and their next fixtures.
